title: Auto Torch
description: Automatically places torches in dark areas while you're holding one, making cave exploration and mining smoother.
body:
AutoTorch is a simple quality-of-life mod that automatically places torches when the area around you gets dark.

As long as you are holding a torch in your main hand or off hand, the mod will look for a nearby valid block and place a torch for you. This makes cave exploration, mining, and underground travel feel smoother without constantly stopping to light up the area by hand.

It is designed to stay lightweight and close to vanilla gameplay. AutoTorch does not change how torches work — it simply helps you place them at the right time.

Client-side only. No server installation required.
